en:
What is it, sour tits!? You better have a damn
good reason for buggin' THIS beautiful genius!
S-Sour...tits...
<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah, I'll just pretend I didn't hear that...

Nothing much... I just wanted to talk to
you for a bit.
Huh? Talk?

Why the fuck do I gotta talk to you, dumpy
tits?
Dumpy tits...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Just grin and bear it... You can do it...
I'm the one who decided to talk to her...

Well, I am bored. How 'bout you start talkin'
about something that'll interest me?

You got no boobs and nothin' interestin'
to say! You're fuckin' hopeless!

Hah-hahaha! Poor widdle Kaede and her
sad, sour, dumpy tits!

Wha—!? Wh-Who you callin' sad, sour,
dumpy tits, huh!?
Heeeee!?

Wh-What the—!? Don't shout all of a sudden...
You know how fuckin' rude that is?

You're the rude one here! I was holding it
in, but this is the last straw!

Huh? Oh, I get it.
Don't tell me...
Is having big boobs that great?
Boobs are just lumps of fat!
My boobs are pretty big!
Are you unsure of something?

You're jealous of my fine sexy body!
Hah-hahaha!
Is having big boobs that great?

Duh-doy! A woman can't get anywhere in
life unless she's got big tits!

Small, pathetic tits are only popular among
a certain class of creepers...

Wait a minute... You're not tryin' to attract
those creepy fucks, are you?
Boobs are just lumps of fat!

That's what all the jealous titless bitches say!
Why don'tcha go cry about it, muffintop!?
I-I don't have a muffintop!

Pianists don't hafta do any physical or mental
activity. That's why they're all fatasses, huh?
Hey! My boobs are pretty big, y'know!

Yeah? Feelin' pretty confident about that?
Then lemme get a feel—

Aaaaahhh!
Wh-What are you doing!?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*pow!*
Motherfu—!

What the hell...? What's your problem? 
We're both chicks, aren't we...?

That doesn't matter! Geez, what goes on
in your head!?

Ah-hah! Those fake tits aren't foolin' me!
What's your secret—pads, stuffing, or silicon?
Th-They're real!
God, Miu! Some things are best left unsaid!

Fuck that! I'm Miu fuckin' Iruma and I'll say
whatever I goddamn fuckin' want!

No, you can't! If you keep acting like this,
everyone will get sick of you!

Fine by me! A true genius is never
understood in her time!

Hahahahaha! C'mon, c'mon! Don't leave me
hangin'! I wanna hear you talk more shit!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Miu's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>After arguing with Miu, I parted ways with her
and returned to my room.
<CLT=cltMIND>*sigh* I'm seriously tired...
